description: Instagram competitor analysis for Reels: breaks down any public account's posting pace, median and average views, outlier reels, best day and hour, winning duration, audio and hashtags, then compares it against the user's own account and turns the gaps into a 2-week action list. Use when the user says "analyze this competitor", "spy on @account", "what is @handle doing differently", "competitor report", "compare me with", or "why does their content get more views". Reads IShort competitor reports via the MCP (list_my_competitor_reports, get_competitor_report) or an IShort CSV export.
